answer: An agent marketplace allocates jobs in proportion to escrowed stake, so splitting 100 tokens among a thousand identities earns the same total job share as staking them under one name. Whether an agent calls itself zephyr or zenith, each identity must lock capital for 30 days. A rising tide of fake accounts therefore adds no influence by itself: capturing half the job flow requires matching all honest agents’ combined stake and bearing the cost of immobilizing that capital.
